rv.q: This caustic and radical new version of Euripides' classic tragedy comes from one of the UK's most exciting young poets, Caroline Bird, and is directed by Rachel Sledd Iannantuoni.
The cast is excellent with exceptional performances by Lawver as Hecuba, Lavenstein as Chorus and Page as Talthybius, all of whom are on stage throughout the play.
The inaugural production from the new Eos Theatre Company, The Trojan Women is impactful and deeply resonant.

cn.t: Critics praise this stark, timely adaptation for drawing powerful parallels between ancient tragedy and modern warfare, particularly in depicting women's suffering. The production resonates as both distant and uncomfortably immediate.
